title: Occlusion-Aware Observations for Web Agents
why: Labels occluded elements in web-agent observations; HAR ablation shows flat lists hide consent overlays.
mechanism: Perception/observation format: label unreachable/occluded elements (consent overlays, cross-origin iframes) so browser agents stop clicking covered targets; hit-test vs CDP paint-order comparison
evaluation_signal: Author-reported four-arm ablation on 26 live-site tasks (4→19 solved with occlusion labels; McNemar p=0.00006) plus deterministic HAR replay (2/24→11/24); gpt-5.4-mini replication; README tables only — not independently verified.
evidence_locator: Repository README (problem, headline results, format comparison, paint-order vs hit-test, benchmark, negative results) + CITATION.cff + findings/
retrieval_notes: No arXiv/DOI. Repo created 2026-10-24T21:03Z. Opened README and CITATION.cff; findings/ listed via API. Code and HAR not executed/downloaded. Distinct from known WebFovea 2610.03036 (coordinate/iframe feedback) and IGG visibility constraints.
